title: Decouple Management NL ask, OpenClaw ops, assistant provider and high-risk refusal test suites
summary: Decoupled 6 target test suites (114 test cases across Management NL ask, OpenClaw ops surface, assistant provider, NL high-risk refusal, security hardening, and single-owner seam) from BFF main.py composition root imports, global monkeypatching (main.read_store, bff_main.read_store, app_deps.read_surface =), and sys.path surgery. Replaced direct composition root imports with dynamic module resolution via rebalance_authority_test_support, isolated TestClient harnesses, and test-scoped read store bindings on both BFF composition and context read services while preserving 100% of test assertions and contracts. Decreased inventory live_scan_non_whitelisted_main_importer_ceiling from 66 to 60 on rebased dev, registered all 6 suites in migrated_suites (bringing total migrated suites to 17), verified all 8 architecture invariant tests pass, and achieved 100% pass rate (114/114 passed) across the migrated test suites.

services/control-plane/bff/test_openclaw.technique: Removed direct AST imports of BFF main.py composition root; accessed handlers and types via dynamic module helper in rebalance_authority_test_support; removed sys.path manipulation.

services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_bf.technique: Decoupled static main import; replaced bff_main.read_store assignment with set_management_nl_read_store test helper; preserved all multi-tenant security hardening and query scoping assertions.
Replaced static main import with dynamic module helper; used bound_management_nl_store for read_store lifecycle management; preserved all high-risk mutation refusal assertions.

Decoupled main import in favor of dynamic helper; replaced direct bff_main.read_store and bff_main._sse_buffers mutations with bound_management_nl_store, get_management_nl_sse_buffer, and clear_management_nl_sse_buffer; preserved deterministic synthesis and event stream contracts.

services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_ma.technique: Decoupled bff_main import and sys.path manipulation; rewired test-scoped read store through set_management_nl_read_store to update both composition root and _management_ai_context_service; preserved all provider failover, streaming, idempotency, and multimodal contracts.
Removed sys.path.insert and import main; resolved handler methods and stores through dynamic module helper; ensured dual read_store binding across main and persona service for replay streams.
